client_request_id: unique retry correlation; duplicate requests must not duplicate effects

authority.LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT: local simulation allowed and visibly labelled

critical_rules: Client-side success never proves ownership, currency or entitlement on a live environment.
Wallet, premium entitlement and persistent ownership commits are server authoritative.
Duplicate transaction/client_request IDs must be idempotent.
Revision conflicts require refresh/reconciliation rather than blind overwrite.
